### 1 — Scene
A light fruit-and-salad meal: strawberries, blueberries and pineapple beside leafy salad with cucumber and shredded carrot.

### 2 — Vessel
A shallow bowl or deep dinner plate, approximately **26 cm diameter**.  
Vessel area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods: pineapple chunks, strawberries, blueberries, leafy greens, cucumber and carrot shreds. The salad looks lightly glossy; I include a small, uncertain allowance for dressing.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Food occupies approximately **46% of the vessel’s area**. Areas below divide the visible footprint without counting overlapping ingredients twice. Dressing coats the salad rather than occupying additional area.

| Item | Vessel area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Pineapple | 9% | 48 cm² × 2 cm = 96 ml | 0.65 | 62 | 50 | 31 |
| Strawberries | 12% | 64 cm² × 2 cm = 128 ml | 0.60 | 77 | 32 | 25 |
| Blueberries | 3% | 16 cm² × 1 cm = 16 ml | 0.65 | 10 | 57 | 6 |
| Leafy greens | 15% | 80 cm² × 2 cm = 160 ml | 0.15 | 24 | 20 | 5 |
| Cucumber | 5% | 27 cm² × 0.7 cm = 19 ml | 0.65 | 12 | 15 | 2 |
| Shredded carrot | 2% | 11 cm² × 0.4 cm = 4.4 ml | 0.60 | 3 | 41 | 1 |
| Light oil-based dressing, uncertain | Coating | Approximately 4 ml | 1.0 | 4 | 600 | 24 |

### 8 — Sanity check
**Estimated total: 192 g and 94 kcal.** This is plausible for a partially filled plate of fruit and a small, loose salad. Dressing is the largest energy uncertainty; without it, the estimate is about 70 kcal.
